title: Webmention request, outbound record, and verification result
description: The W3C mechanism reused without invention (POST source/target) plus structural verification (spec 15). OPTIONAL at every level; a static-only deployment advertises no endpoint and remains conformant.

Status.description: Lifecycle of an inbound mention. 'gone' is set when a source that verified before now fails, including a withdrawal endcap (spec 15.4).

OutboundRecord.description: Sender-side record of one outbound mention; delivery is fire-and-forget and never a publish outcome (spec 15.2).

targetVersionSeen.description: Used to re-send only when new or changed (spec 15.2).

VerificationResult.description: What a receiver records after structural verification. A pointer only: NO content is stored (spec 15.4 rule 5).

notes: Verification reads a reference's identity members only and MUST NOT consult cited (spec 15.4).
The relation set is exactly stub, transclusion, fork (spec 15.4).
Plain (non-structural) mentions, if accepted, MUST be held apart (spec 15.6).
Bounds are MUSTs: at most 2 fetches (3 under templates), 3 redirects, 5s per fetch, 1MB per body (spec 14, 15.4).
